
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- thermostat.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- thermostat.volt:10[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `target_temp` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim] 9 |[/dim] 
 [dim]10 |[/dim] storage target_temp: int = 22
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("target_temp", target_temp)` after changing it.[/cyan]
